All 42 revised pairs reread with exact source afterward. alignment_check.scope: All source-English pairs and all revised pairs individually read. Final 1523 English verses have unique canonical first-source IDs; grouped fragments and explicit nonverse/unresolved exclusions account for every extraction record on PDF156–175 except20 watermarks.
